title: The 49th Passenger
description: You wash ashore after the crash with the flight manifest in your pocket: 48 passengers. But the beach holds 49 sets of footprints — and one trail leads into the jungle.

n1.caption: You wake face-down on wet sand, the flight manifest still clutched in your fist: 48 passengers. But the beach holds 49 sets of footprints — and one trail leads into the jungle.

n2a.caption: The trail ends at a bunker hatch half-buried in roots. Fresh cigarette smoke rises from its vent — someone has been living down there, and they smoked one an hour ago.

n2b.caption: In the tail section you find a sealed emergency kit — and a second manifest, identical to yours, except for one thing: passenger 49 is listed, and the name is yours.

n3a.caption: The hatch swings open. A woman in a captain's jacket looks you up and down and sighs: 'You're early. The plane doesn't arrive for another three days.'

n3b.caption: Inside: bunks, a radio still warm — and a wall covered in manifests. Every one ends in a crash. Every one lists exactly 49 names.

n3c.caption: The bunker door is already open. On the table sit two cups of coffee, still steaming, and a note in careful handwriting: 'We counted too.'

n3d.caption: The manifests curl and burn to black. Behind you the jungle goes silent — every bird stops at once, like something just noticed you.
